name: SE(3) Deformation Field
definition: Encodes scene deformation as a rigid transformation (rotation + translation) per point using a screw axis, replacing per-point translation fields to simplify optimization by requiring a single rotation parameter across space.
summary: The SE(3) Deformation Field encodes scene deformation as a rigid transformation per point using screw axis parameters, simplifying optimization by requiring a single rotation parameter across space rather than distinct translation vectors for each point.
